excluded.AlexClark: 3 holes annotated -- these are the BENT holes, deliberately chosen as the hard case. Excluded from margin DERIVATION (its 15 unannotated holes cannot confirm zero-loss) but retained as a SCORING course: a tier that clips a bent hole is disqualified.

measuredNote: Margins are fractions of image W/H, applied per-image, so they are scale-free. Derived from the 4 fully-annotated courses; scored against all 5.

gates.gate1: avg 10% cut, 0 loss -- MET by T1 (13.74%) and T2 (18.13%)
gates.gate2: avg 25% cut, 0 loss -- NOT met by any blind crop; ceiling is ~22.4%. Requires object-aware cutting.

lessons: Mask density is NOT a course-region signal. Zero fully-empty rows or columns on Heritage; p1 row density is 5.9%. The margins are more satellite imagery, not blank space.
T3-edge sits exactly on the worst observed margin and still clips Lenard by one point. Never set a bound at the extreme you measured; that is what the safety factor is for.
Emitted artifacts carry no object coordinates -- assignment.selection.table holds only ids and scores. An object-aware cut (gate 2) is not computable from what the algorithm emits today.
